title: Metadata Provider Depth And Precision
problem: Built-in metadata providers have capability and matching foundations, but provider depth, subject identity, and per-kind precision are still too coarse for future Admin governance and safe automatic refresh.
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-metadata tmdb_provider metadata_candidate --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Opened the provider depth and precision lane from GAARA closeout and metadata provider breadth residual risk.
TMDB series fetch now projects season summaries into MetadataCandidateGraph related nodes and contains relationships without schema, Public Client API, Web, or Generated Artifact apply changes.
Refresh guard coverage proves provider graph preview nodes do not create child Media Items, child Provider Subjects, or child Provider Mappings; refresh persists only the root Provider Subject.
Split follow-ons into separate proposed lanes for TMDB episode graph depth, Bangumi relations/episodes, Douban subject precision, durable candidate review, and Admin/Web provider depth governance.
Closed the lane after TMDB graph preview, root-only refresh guard, and explicit follow-on routing.

continue_policy.notes: Lane target is complete. Open a new workstream for TMDB episode graph depth, Bangumi relations/episodes, Douban subject precision, durable candidate review, or Admin/Web provider depth governance.
